# tailworks

> tailworks is a self-hosted, tailnet-native runtime for Cloudflare-style Workers and Durable Objects on stock workerd. Every workload and every Durable Object instance is its own Tailscale tailnet node; callers are identified by WireGuard identity (`getCaller`), not tokens. You drive it with the `tw` CLI; every command takes `--json`.

Coding agents: start with the skills. `tw agent setup` installs them for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and OpenCode; `tw agent show <skill>` prints one; `tw docs search <words>` and `tw docs show <doc>[#<anchor>]` read these docs offline, at the version of the installed CLI (all but the API and design section below).

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/README.md): what tailworks is, the quick start, and the compatibility table
- [Docs map](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/README.md): every doc by role and by task (learn, do, look up, understand)
- CLI reference: docs/cli.md (below) has every command and flag; `tw help` groups the commands, `tw <command> --help` shows one
- [Using tailworks with a coding agent](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/agents.md): skills, `tw agent setup`, safety rules
- [Agent skills](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/agent/skills/tw/SKILL.md): the core skill; the others are next to it in agent/skills/
- [Concepts](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/concepts.md): the words tailworks uses (tenant, workload, object, tiers, facet mode, pool nodes, warm keys)
- [Alternatives to tailworks](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/alternatives.md): what tailworks adds to stock workerd, a dated comparison with celld, workerd on its own, OpenOrange, Rivet, Cloudflare Mesh and tsnet, and when not to use it
- [Installing tailworks](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/INSTALL.md): macOS and Linux, npm or the tarball, the OAuth client, `tw link`, the service, the microVM tier, backup, restore and uninstall
- [More than one machine](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/hosts.md): `tw host add`, where a workload runs (placement), how many objects a host holds
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/troubleshooting.md): `tw up` fails; a first deploy doesn't answer (the caller grant, `identity_pending`, tagOwners after a rename, `peer_not_visible`, a `failed` deployment); `tw link` and linked machines; `tw doctor` warnings
- [What tailworks runs on a host](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/footprint.md): processes, ports, tailnet devices, state files and the microVM tier's root-owned helper
- [Where the install is tested](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/install-testing.md): the Linux support matrix and measured timings
- [Postgres and mgmt replicas](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/postgres.md): when to switch, `tw-mgmt migrate --from sqlite`, `tw up --db-file`, backups with Postgres, HA replicas
- [Upgrading tailworks](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/upgrading.md): what may run together, `tw upgrade`, fleet upgrade runs, cordon and drain
- [Changelog](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md): what changed in each release, breaking changes and upgrade actions first
- [The launch demo](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/demo.md): `scripts/demo.sh` (an MCP server and an agent deployed, a tool call allowed then denied by one grant, `tw kill`), the throwaway Headscale tailnet, how to record it
- [Releasing tailworks](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/RELEASING.md): versions, release-note fragments, the release gates
- [Running tailworks on Headscale](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/headscale.md): the Headscale profile, `tw up --control=headscale`, what's different from Tailscale

## Building apps

- [Recipes](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/recipes.md): short, runnable how-tos: tailnet gateways for internet APIs and LLMs, a Durable Object per user, a signed public webhook, cron into KV
- [tailworks.jsonc reference](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/tailworks-jsonc.md): every key, tags and `tw init`
- [Using wrangler with tailworks](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/wrangler.md): wrangler.toml/json/jsonc, `--env`, bundling, what's ignored
- [Testing a tailworks app](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/testing.md): `npm test` in the templates, `@tailworks/tailnet/testing` (`withCaller`, a fake `ctx.tailnet`), `@cloudflare/vitest-plugin`, `tw dev --caller` and `startDev`
- [Cloudflare Workers compatibility](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/COMPAT.md): what works, surface by surface, with the tests behind it
- [Worker secrets](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/secrets.md): `tw secret`, `.dev.vars`
- [Workers KV](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/kv.md): `kv_namespaces`, `tw kv`, consistency and limits
- [R2 buckets](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/r2.md): `r2_buckets` bindings, the `fs` / `s3` blob backends, `tw r2`
- [D1 databases](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/d1.md): `d1_databases`, wrangler migrations, `tw d1`, sessions and limits
- [Queues](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/queues.md): `queues.producers` / `queues.consumers`, `queue()`, retries, dead-letter queues, `tw queues`
- [Cron triggers](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/cron-triggers.md): `triggers.crons`, `scheduled()`
- [Workflows and approvals](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/approvals.md): Cloudflare Workflows, `AgentWorkflow`, `waitForApproval`; approvals decided by tailnet identities under `github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/cap/approve`, `tw approve`
- [Public ingress (Funnel)](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/public-ingress.md): public routes, `tw expose`
- [MCP for hosted assistants](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/mcp-public.md): one MCP endpoint for claude.ai / ChatGPT connectors over public ingress, OAuth tokens from tsidp, `withTailnet` `publicOAuth`, `requester()`
- [Tailscale Services](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/services.md): stable names and replicas
- [Locks and leader election](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/locks.md): Durable Objects as locks, leases, fencing tokens, the `lock` template, failure guarantees
- [Per-object egress](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/egress-modes.md): facet mode vs plain-DO mode
- [Create admission](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/create-admission.md): how a new Durable Object gets made
- [Containers and code sandboxes](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/containers.md): `ctx.container` on the microVM tier
- [The Node process tier](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/node-tier.md): `"runtime": "node"`
- [Python Workers](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/python.md): Pyodide, `main = "src/entry.py"`, Python Durable Objects, vendored packages, the `python` template

## Operating and debugging

- [CLI reference](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/cli.md): every command and subcommand with its flags and defaults (generated from --help)
- [CLI --json output](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/cli-json.md): result documents, NDJSON events, the error shape
- [CLI --json schema](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/schema/cli.schema.json): JSON Schema of every command's output
- [Debugging in tw dev](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/dev-debugging.md): running an app with no tailnet, source-mapped stacks, `req.url`, `--inspector-port` (Chrome DevTools, VS Code), hotkeys
- [Observability](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/observability.md): request records (`tw logs`), Prometheus `/metrics`, OTLP export (`tw telemetry`), traces
- [Error catalog](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/errors.md): every error code and its fix
- [Limits](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/limits.md): every size, count, rate and timeout, with the flag or constant it comes from, and the limits that don't exist
- [Admin UI](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/ADMIN-UI.md): the operator console
- [Teams](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/teams.md): tenant admins under `github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/cap/tenant-admin`, one team per tenant
- [tailworks.jsonc JSON Schema](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/schema/tailworks.schema.json): for editor completion

## API and design

- [Management API](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/contracts/mgmt-api.md): the REST v1 contract, rendered from api/openapi.yaml
- [OpenAPI spec](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/api/openapi.yaml): the source of truth for /v1
- [tw-hostd API](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/contracts/hostd-api.md): the host agent's routes, mgmt → hostd and the operator's local socket
- [RFC](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/design/RFC.md): the design
- [Architecture decision records](https://github.com/rosskukulinski/tailworks/blob/master/docs/design/adr/README.md): one file per decision
